method: SuperMimic Appendix B/G joint motion and RL velocity interfaces
command_range_note: Embodiment-specific low-speed Sprite operating envelope; algorithmic sampling matches paper. Not the G1 benchmark's much wider range.
precision_note: MLP-only BF16 as in C. Zhang's implementation; integration/FK/rewards remain FP32. Global TF32 was rejected by the unchanged FK check. See November 12 benchmark and fixed-input precision evidence.
embodiment_notes: 31-DoF Sprite v5, physical model/PD/timing differ from G1; published hyperparameter differences remain explicit.
reference_reuse: PM01 G71 phase-preserving contact and 25mm clearance correction; preserved non-leg joints and root orientation; bounded root translation; 11.42s single clip; no dance.
imu_frame_verification_note: Operator confirmed on 2026-11-12 that the ICM-45686 is rigidly mounted on the pelvis. Train root/pelvis gyro in rad/s and unit projected gravity; retain the validated installation transform.
dataset_scope: First PM01 baseline, not a reproduction of the paper locomotion library; command-conditioned RL remains joint with motion tracking.

recovery_impulses.protocol: World-frame velocity jump before observation/transition; WM windows stop across the jump; policy history is continuous. Not a finite-duration external force model.

comparison: Fresh seed43 with the same corrected reference; only the bounded motion-interface sole-height reward differs from the completed reference-only comparison.
activation_gate: Review the completed reference-only physical gait before launching; not an automatic replacement of the active run.
